{{Top|leg}}
A '''cargo shunt''' was a [[repulsorlift]] system akin to a conveyor belt aboard [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] that assisted in the transportation of cargo from the storage bay to the unloading gate. Cargo shunts could also be used to deploy [[Conner net]]s, and using the cargo shunt to deploy [[trac-reflective]] shroud particles was part of a [[Covert Shroud Maneuver]].
